title.en: How many days did it take?

hints.tr: `date(yıl, ay, gün)`; sıra her zaman yıl, ay, gün. İki tarihin farkı bir `timedelta`, gün sayısı `.days`.
hints.en: `date(year, month, day)`; the order is always year, month, day. The difference of two dates is a `timedelta`; the number of days is `.days`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
from datetime import date

order = date(2024, 2, 27)
delivery = date(2024, 3, 4)

print((delivery - order).days)
print(delivery.strftime("%A"))

order_2023 = date(2023, 2, 27)
delivery_2023 = date(2023, 3, 4)
print((delivery_2023 - order_2023).days)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
from datetime import date

order = date(2024, 2, 27)
delivery = date(2024, 3, 4)

print((delivery - order).days)
print(delivery.strftime("%A"))

order_2023 = date(2023, 2, 27)
delivery_2023 = date(2023, 3, 4)
print((delivery_2023 - order_2023).days)
```
